```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("presentation_setup.R")
```

The two personas on the slides are based on real, anonymized holdout applicants,
scored by the final model. The names are made up. Each applicant's prediction is
split into contributions (SHAP values) that show which parts of the application
pushed the risk up or down.

**Decision rule used for the personas:** the riskiest 10% of applicants by model
score are denied; everyone else is approved. Change `deny_share` to try another rule.

```{r rule}
deny_share <- 0.10
cutoff <- quantile(holdout_prob, 1 - deny_share)

ho <- holdout_data |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number(),
         prob = holdout_prob,
         risk_percentile = percent_rank(prob),
         decision = if_else(prob >= cutoff, "Deny", "Approve"))

tibble(`Deny if predicted risk is at least` = pct(cutoff),
       `Average predicted risk` = pct(mean(ho$prob))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Candidate applicants

**Approved candidate:** no credit bureau record (the borrower a traditional bank turns
away), repaid, in the safest half of applicants, has at least two outside scores, aged
22 to 35, currently employed.

**Denied candidate:** in the riskiest 10%, actually had payment difficulties, aged 22
to 45, and does have a credit bureau record (so the denial is not about missing history).

```{r candidates}
profile_cols <- c("row_id", "prob", "risk_percentile", "TARGET", "age_years",
                  "CODE_GENDER", "years_employed", "NAME_INCOME_TYPE",
                  "OCCUPATION_TYPE", "NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE", "NAME_FAMILY_STATUS",
                  "CNT_CHILDREN", "NAME_HOUSING_TYPE", "AMT_INCOME_TOTAL",
                  "AMT_CREDIT", "AMT_GOODS_PRICE", "AMT_ANNUITY", "ltv",
                  "ext_source_mean", "ext_source_count", "has_bureau_record",
                  "bureau_credits", "fields_missing", "NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE")

approved_candidates <- ho |>
  filter(has_bureau_record == 0, TARGET == 0, risk_percentile <= 0.5,
         ext_source_count >= 2, between(age_years, 22, 35),
         not_currently_employed == 0, OCCUPATION_TYPE != "Missing") |>
  arrange(prob) |>
  slice(seq(1, n(), length.out = min(5, n())) |> round())   # spread across the group

denied_candidates <- ho |>
  filter(decision == "Deny", TARGET == 1, between(age_years, 22, 45),
         has_bureau_record == 1, OCCUPATION_TYPE != "Missing") |>
  arrange(desc(prob)) |>
  slice(seq(1, n(), length.out = min(5, n())) |> round())

approved_candidates |> select(any_of(profile_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Approved candidates")
denied_candidates |> select(any_of(profile_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Denied candidates")
```

Pick one of each. The defaults take the first row of each table; change the numbers
to use a different candidate.

```{r pick}
approved_pick <- 3
denied_pick   <- 1

personas <- bind_rows(
  approved_candidates |> slice(approved_pick) |> mutate(persona = "Approved"),
  denied_candidates   |> slice(denied_pick)   |> mutate(persona = "Denied")
)
```

## Why the model decided what it did

```{r explain}
ex <- explain_applicants(final_internal_xgb, personas)
stopifnot(max(abs(ex$prob - personas$prob)) < 1e-4)  # contributions add up to the score

contrib <- ex$long |>
  mutate(persona = personas$persona[row], theme = theme_of(variable))

by_theme <- contrib |>
  group_by(persona, theme) |>
  summarise(contribution = sum(contribution), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(abs(contribution) > 0.005) |>
  arrange(persona, desc(abs(contribution)))

by_feature <- contrib |>
  filter(contribution != 0) |>
  group_by(persona) |>
  slice_max(abs(contribution), n = 8) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(contribution > 0, "raises risk", "lowers risk"))

by_theme |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(contribution > 0, "raises risk", "lowers risk"),
         contribution = round(contribution, 3)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Contribution by theme (log-odds; positive = riskier)")
by_feature |>
  select(persona, column, value, contribution, direction) |>
  mutate(across(c(value, contribution), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Top 8 individual drivers per persona")

write_csv(by_theme,   file.path(results_dir, "persona_drivers_by_theme.csv"))
write_csv(by_feature, file.path(results_dir, "persona_drivers_by_feature.csv"))
```

```{r persona-charts, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
for (p in c("Approved", "Denied")) {
  d <- by_theme |> filter(persona == p) |> slice_max(abs(contribution), n = 7)
  g <- ggplot(d, aes(contribution, fct_reorder(theme, abs(contribution)),
                     fill = contribution > 0)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#CC0000", `FALSE` = "#1E2761"),
                      labels = c(`TRUE` = "Raises risk", `FALSE` = "Lowers risk"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = paste0(p, " persona: what moved the score"),
         x = "Contribution to predicted risk (log-odds)", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) + theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(g)
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, paste0("persona_", tolower(p), "_drivers.png")),
         g, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 200)
}
```

## Summary for the slides

```{r summary}
avg_risk <- mean(ho$prob)
fmt_profile <- function(r) {
  c(sprintf("- Predicted risk: %s (average applicant %s); riskier than %s of applicants; decision: %s",
            pct(r$prob), pct(avg_risk), pct(r$risk_percentile), r$decision),
    sprintf("- Actual outcome: %s", if_else(r$TARGET == 1, "had payment difficulties", "repaid")),
    sprintf("- Age %d, %s, %s; employed %s years; %s",
            round(r$age_years), r$CODE_GENDER, r$NAME_FAMILY_STATUS,
            round(r$years_employed, 1), r$NAME_INCOME_TYPE),
    sprintf("- Occupation: %s; education: %s; housing: %s; children: %s",
            r$OCCUPATION_TYPE, r$NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE, r$NAME_HOUSING_TYPE, r$CNT_CHILDREN),
    sprintf("- Loan %s (%s) for goods priced %s, loan-to-value %.2f; income %s",
            num(r$AMT_CREDIT), r$NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE, num(r$AMT_GOODS_PRICE), r$ltv,
            num(r$AMT_INCOME_TOTAL)),
    sprintf("- Outside score average %.2f from %d score(s); credit bureau record: %s; blank fields: %d",
            r$ext_source_mean, as.integer(r$ext_source_count),
            if_else(r$has_bureau_record == 1, "yes", "no"), as.integer(r$fields_missing)))
}
lines <- c("# Persona results", "",
           sprintf("Rule: deny the riskiest %s (predicted risk at least %s).",
                   pct(deny_share, 0), pct(cutoff)), "")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(personas))) {
  r <- personas[i, ]
  th <- by_theme |> filter(persona == r$persona)
  lower <- th |> filter(contribution < 0) |> head(3)
  raise <- th |> filter(contribution > 0) |> head(3)
  lines <- c(lines, paste0("## ", r$persona, " persona (holdout row ", r$row_id, ")"),
             fmt_profile(r),
             "- Biggest factors lowering risk:",
             paste0("  - ", lower$theme, " (", round(lower$contribution, 2), ")"),
             "- Biggest factors raising risk:",
             paste0("  - ", raise$theme, " (", round(raise$contribution, 2), ")"),
             "")
}
writeLines(lines, file.path(results_dir, "persona_summary.md"))
cat(lines, sep = "\n")
```
